title: Repo review verdicts
description: Output of the verify pass: a judgment on one prior finding. A verify agent typically returns every verdict for a file's findings at once (verdictBatch), so the top-level schema accepts either a single verdict object or a batch of them.

verdict.description: One verify agent's judgment on one finding.

id.description: Matches the id of the finding this verdict is about.

rationale.description: Free text explaining the verdict; must quote the source line it rests on.

fixable_in_place.description: Whether the issue can be fixed with a local, self-contained edit.

verifier.description: The model tag that produced this verdict, e.g. "opus".

verdictBatch.description: One verify agent's verdicts for every finding in a file, returned together.
